name: @jugaaadi/db-browser-connectors
description: Metadata-driven database connector registry for @jugaaadi/db-browser: descriptors as data, drivers downloaded on demand, one shared SqlDataSource. Node only.
author: Mateen Khan
//: Every driver is an OPTIONAL peer. That is the whole point of this package: the registry lists every engine with nothing installed, and a driver is downloaded only when a connection needs it. Adding one of these to `dependencies` would ship the connectors, which is exactly what the design refuses to do.
